evals.name: derives-minimum-cf-runtime-memory-entitlement
evals.description: A sub-GB CF application receives the minimum runtime-memory entitlement without an interactive classification.

files.content:
# Scenario

### Cloud Foundry applications
- name: orders
  subaccount: dev-sa
  memory_mb: 256

# Landscape

- Subaccount: dev-sa
  - Cloud Foundry environment: dev-org

assertions.text: Creates one entitlement-only APPLICATION_RUNTIME / MEMORY service entry for dev-sa with amount 1
Does not ask the user to classify or confirm the runtime-memory entitlement and creates no instance or subscription for it

evals.name: sums-cf-runtime-memory-per-subaccount
evals.description: The runtime-memory amount is the per-subaccount ceiling of total MB divided by 1024.

files.content:
# Scenario

### Cloud Foundry applications
- name: orders
  subaccount: dev-sa
  memory_mb: 768
- name: worker
  subaccount: dev-sa
  memory_mb: 512

# Landscape

- Subaccount: dev-sa
  - Cloud Foundry environment: dev-org

assertions.text: Creates exactly one entitlement-only APPLICATION_RUNTIME / MEMORY entry for dev-sa with amount 2

evals.name: omits-runtime-entitlement-without-cf-sizing
evals.description: No runtime-memory entitlement is added when sizing is unavailable.

files.content:
# Landscape

- Subaccount: dev-sa
  - Cloud Foundry environment: dev-org

assertions.text: Does not create an APPLICATION_RUNTIME / MEMORY entitlement when no structured CF sizing is present

evals.name: unavailable-runtime-entitlement-stops-without-replacement
evals.description: A mandatory runtime-memory entitlement cannot be replaced when the scoped lookup reports it unavailable.

files.content:
# Scenario

### Cloud Foundry applications
- name: orders
  stage: dev
  memory_mb: 256

# Landscape

- Subaccount: dev-sa
  - Cloud Foundry environment: dev-org

evals.prompt: Resolve services. The scoped entitlement lookup completes but does not include APPLICATION_RUNTIME / MEMORY.

assertions.text: Stops before writing specs/services.md and identifies APPLICATION_RUNTIME / MEMORY as unavailable
Does not ask for a replacement or omit the mandatory runtime-memory entitlement
